    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    van_patches = image_patch.find("van")
    red_van_patches = [v for v in van_patches if v.verify_property("van", "red")]
    stalls_patches = image_patch.find("stalls")
    
    if not red_van_patches or not stalls_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    near_stalls = [v for v in red_van_patches if distance(v, stalls_patches[0]) < 0]
    
    return near_stalls[0] if near_stalls else red_van_patches[0]
